_meta.note: KAS 0.66.104 run as Kiro Crew's own bundled engine (kiro-cli not installed, so the KAS route is the bundle), captured by KIROCREW_ACP_RECORD_FRAMES on an isolated gateway with a fresh data home and no Kiro sign-in, after one chat message from the dashboard. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except the home directory, which reads as ~. Kept: the engine's `_kiro/auth/getAccessToken` request (id 0), which the gateway could not answer because nothing is signed in; the initialize response; and the engine's answer to the chat's session/prompt (id 4): a -32000 whose data.errorType is SignInRequiredError, the field Kiro Crew reads to tag the turn as a sign-in error. Omitted: the session/new response (its modes and models list the host's agents and entitlements), every session/update, the host inventory notifications (_kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/tools/didChange, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/governance/state, _kiro/policy/changed, _kiro/progressive_context/items_changed, _kiro/memory/syncStatus), and the frames of the gateway's other sessions (prompt suggestions, session naming).

error.message: Sign in to Kiro to send a prompt.
